item.title: The Philippines: Senate OKs Blockchain-Based Budget System
item.description: The Philippine Senate unanimously approved the CADENA Act, establishing a secure blockchain-based system to make government spending fully transparent, traceable and publicly fully accountable and monitored.

item.title: Australia: NSW’s Smart Component-Based Email Design System
item.description: The email system provides government agencies with a unified, accessible, and highly efficient framework for designing, building, and deploying consistent, high-quality email communications.

item.title: Vietnam’s Ward- and Commune-Level Digital Ecosystem
item.description: Vietnam has launched a comprehensive digital transformation ecosystem for ward- and commune-level administrations to modernise governance, enhance public services and support local economic development.

item.title: Singapore: Digital Upgrade Transforms Migrant Worker Healthcare
item.description: The Ministry of Manpower is enhancing the Primary Care Plan with digital tools, telemedicine and system optimisations to improve access, efficiency and resilience in migrant worker healthcare.

item.title: Australia: ACSC Guides Organisations on Quantum Cybersecurity
item.description: The Australian Cyber Security Centre has released a Quantum Technology Primer to help organisations understand emerging quantum technologies, their cybersecurity implications and prepare.

item.title: Vietnam: Smart, Green and Digital Development in Action
item.description: Vietnam is pursuing rapid and sustainable growth by integrating digital transformation, technology, innovation and green practices across all sectors, positioning itself as a regional and global leader in development.

item.title: Hong Kong: New AI Funding Accelerates Digital Learning in Schools
item.description: Hong Kong has launched a HK$500 million, three-year funding programme to support schools in systematically integrating artificial intelligence into teaching, learning and student skill development.

item.title: The Philippines: AI-Powered e-TURO Pilot Drives Digital Learning
item.description: The Philippines is advancing inclusive, future-ready education by piloting AI-powered learning, expanding digital access and providing skills programmes to empower students and underserved youth.

item.title: Malaysia: Smart Aquaculture Strategies Drive Resilience
item.description: Malaysia is strengthening its aquaculture sector’s resilience through digital monitoring, early warning systems and advanced breeding technologies to safeguard production against climate-related disruptions.

item.title: Singapore, China Advance Tech-Driven Economic Collaboration
item.description: Singapore and China are strengthening cooperation in technology, innovation and the digital economy, advancing digital connectivity, financial innovation and research partnerships to support regional growth.
